question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Pull a fast one.

options.text: To produce something that is needed.
To adjust in a difficult situation.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Pull a fast one"** means to deceive someone or play a trick on someone. (किसी को धोखा देना या किसी पर चाल चलना)

 
 
• **Example: **He tried to pull a fast one on his teacher by pretending he was sick.
 
 
 
• **Deceive** refers to causing someone to believe something that is not true, typically in order to gain some personal advantage. (धोखा देना)
 
 
• **Example: **She deceived her friend into thinking she had lost the tickets.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: To help someone urgently** (किसी की तत्काल मदद करना)

 
 
• **Example:** He rushed to the hospital to help his friend urgently.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: To produce something that is needed** (जो आवश्यक है उसका उत्पादन करना)
 
 
• **Example: **The factory managed to produce the masks that were needed during the pandemic.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: To adjust in a difficult situation** (कठिन परिस्थिति में समायोजित करना)
 
 
• **Example:** She had to adjust in a difficult situation after losing her job.
